fields.mechanism: Condition monitoring using sensors and automation for early degradation detection
fields.intervention: Implement a multi-sensor condition monitoring system on freight rolling stock to detect draft gear, journal bearing, and coupler degradation before failure at mainline speeds
fields.expected_effect: Early detection of mechanical and electrical equipment degradation, reducing equipment-related failures by at least 50% within 2 years
fields.falsification_test: Deploy system on 100 freight cars and compare failure rates with control group over 12-month period; measure false positive/negative rates
fields.mechanism_source_span: Condition monitoring of rail transport systems has become a phenomenon of global interest over the past half a century. The approaches to condition monitoring of various rail transport systems-especially in the context of rail vehicle subsystem and track subsystem monitoring-have been evolving, and have become equally significant and challenging. The evolution of the approaches applied to rail systems' condition monitoring has followed manual maintenance, through methods connected to the application of sensors, up to the currently discussed methods and techniques focused on the mutual use of automation, data processing, and exchange.

fields.mechanism: Condition monitoring through mutual use of automation, data processing, and exchange
fields.intervention: Implementation of automated sensor systems with data processing capabilities to detect degradation in rolling stock components before failure
fields.expected_effect: Early detection of draft gear/mechanism defects, journal bearing overheating, and coupler issues before they lead to mainline failures at speeds 7-37 mph
fields.falsification_test: Deploy sensor systems in real freight operations and compare false positive rates and detection times against historical failure data
fields.mechanism_source_span: "the currently discussed methods and techniques focused on the mutual use of automation, data processing, and exchange"
